collectionMethod: Selected Census QuickFacts figures transcribed from the linked official pages on 2026-10-19. API returned missing_key.html; direct QuickFacts fetch returned 403. resolution: County cohorts, not verified addresses or feeder-level deployment sites. Zone assignments are analyst-selected settlement proxies and must be confirmed with each meter's settlement point. No county price measurements or Base eligibility claims.
